## Available benchmarks

### [Study 01: Separated-locus fine-mapping](01_finemapping/separated-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete development benchmark |
| Study type | Fine-mapping and credible-set evaluation |
| Methods | ST-BED BayesC; ST-BED BayesR; ST-CSR SBayesC; ST-CSR SBayesR |
| Architectures | Separated causal loci |
| Replicates or chains | 10 replicates |
| Primary outputs | Marker recovery, causal ranks, credible sets |
| Validation | 40/40 fits; simulation oracles and strict alignment passed |
| Capsule | [v1.1 reproducibility capsule](../results/reference/01_finemapping/separated-development-v1.1/README.md) |

### [Study 02: Single-trait prediction](02_prediction/prediction-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete five-replicate development benchmark |
| Study type | Held-out single-trait prediction |
| Methods | ST-BED BayesC; ST-BED BayesR; ST-CSR SBayesC; ST-CSR SBayesR |
| Architectures | Sparse homogeneous; sparse variance mixture |
| Replicates or chains | One replicate per architecture |
| Primary outputs | Prediction correlation, NMSE, calibration, paired differences |
| Validation | 8/8 fits; training-only scaling, LD and summary statistics |
| Capsule | [Five-replicate capsule](../results/reference/02_prediction/st-bayesc-bayesr-five-replicate-development-v1/README.md); [historical one-replicate capsule](../results/reference/02_prediction/st-bayesc-bayesr-one-replicate-development-v1/README.md) |

### [Study 04: Multichain convergence](04_convergence/convergence-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete multichain development benchmark with five-replicate validation |
| Study type | Operational multichain convergence diagnostics |
| Methods | Matched ST-BED/CSR BayesC and BayesR |
| Architectures | Sparse homogeneous; sparse variance mixture |
| Replicates or chains | Four chains per method; 16 total |

| Validation | 16/16 chains; retained identities and complete checkpoint grid |
| Capsule | [Recommendation-generating capsule](../results/reference/04_convergence/st-multichain-convergence-development-v1/README.md); [five-replicate validation capsule](../results/reference/04_convergence/st-multichain-convergence-validation-five-replicate-v1/README.md) |

### Study 05: Single-trait annotation-informed models

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Interface validated; convergence unsupported under tested pilot design; five-replicate benchmark not started |
| Study type | Annotation-informed mixture probabilities |
| Methods | ST-BED BayesR/BayesRC; ST-CSR SBayesR/SBayesRC |
| Validation | Maximum-history convergence pilot retained locally; prespecified stop condition triggered |

### [Study 06: Single-trait LD operator benchmark](06_ld_operator/ld-operator-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete five-replicate development benchmark |
| Study type | BED, full CSR, block CSR, and block-eigen operator comparison |
| Methods | Matched BayesC/SBayesC and BayesR/SBayesR |
| Architectures | Sparse homogeneous; sparse variance mixture |
| Scale | 2 architectures; 5 replicates; 60 four-chain fits |
| Primary outputs | Operator equivalence, filtering effects, prediction, recovery, convergence, runtime and storage |

## Planned benchmarks

- Fine-mapping with realistic LD.
- High-LD causal architecture.
- Multi-trait prediction after computational optimization.
- Scientific-scale annotation-informed models after convergence redesign.
- Multi-trait operator and prediction benchmarks.
